literal_uncertainty_policy: Preserve uncertain entities/groups as distinct literal whole forms; syntactic decisions are conditional on this exact surface, not adjudicated palaeography.
argument_sort_relaxation: NOUN type only. No new denotation, argument sort or referent is fitted. Unknown noun following qokeedy is syntactically admissible with recipient identity unbound; known wrong recipients would block complete semantics, but no semantic evaluation is run. UNSAT of this broader necessary syntax suffices; SAT never proves full offer.
primary_algorithm: Enumerate every assignment of NOUN/P1/P2 to unknown forms recurrent within each complete unit. For each assignment use dynamic programming over all1/2/3-group clause partitions. Singleton choices are local because each exact form occurs once. Count every complete path, save each repeated assignment and maximal reachable prefix.
joint_policy: If any complete unit is UNSAT, a common dictionary is UNSAT by containment. If all are SAT, the independent shared-category constraint solver decides joint syntax; primary reports JOINT_REQUIRES_SHARED_SOLVER, not a guessed joint PASS.
independent_algorithm: One category variable per exact form and remaining-noun-argument states along each whole sequence; start/end debt0, head opens0/1/2 slots, argument mustNOUN and consumesone. Exact SAT solver audits each unit and shared categories across allunits.
partial_diagnostic: Longest contiguous complete-clause prefix with no skipped group or boundary reset. Tie-break by lexicographically smallest recurrent assignment (-1,1,2), then lexicographically smallest sequence of clause lengths. Retain every later group as UNPARSED; never execute partial semantics.
